ayahs.textArabic: الۤرٰ ۗتِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ وَقُرْاٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ  ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Alif lām rā, tilka āyātul-kitābi wa qur'ānim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Alif. Lam. Ra. THESE ARE MESSAGES of revelation -of a discourse clear in itself and clearly showing the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَوْ كَانُوْا مُسْلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Rubamā yawaddul-lażīna kafarū lau kānū muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And it will come to pass that those who are [now] bent on denying this truth will wish that they had surrendered themselves to God [in their life time].

ayahs.textArabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوْا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوْا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْاَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żarhum ya'kulū wa yatamatta‘ū wa yulhihimul-amalu fa saufa ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Leave them alone; let them eat and enjoy themselves the while the hope [of vain delights] be guiles them: for in time they will come to know [the truth].

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُوْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā wa lahā kitābum ma‘lūm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And never have We destroyed any community [for its wrongdoing] unless a divine writ had (previously] been made known to it;

ayahs.textArabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wa mā yasta'khirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [but remember that] no community can ever forestall [the end of] its term - and neither can they delay [it].

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْ نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ  ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū yā ayyuhal-lażī nuzzila ‘alaihiż-żikru innaka lamajnūn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, they [who deny the truth] say: "O thou unto whom this reminder has [allegedly] been bestowed from on high: verily, thou art mad!

ayahs.textArabic: لَوْمَا تَأْتِيْنَا بِالْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lau mā ta'tīnā bil-malā'ikati in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Why dost thou not bring before us angels, if thou art a man of truth?

ayahs.textArabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةَ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوْٓا اِذًا مُّنْظَرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā nunazzilul-malā'ikata illā bil-ḥaqqi wa mā kānū iżam munẓarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Yet] We never send down angels otherwise than in accordance with the [demands of] truth; and [were the angels to appear now,] lo! they [who reject this divine writ] would have no further respite!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā naḥnu nazzalnaż-żikra wa innā lahū laḥāfiẓūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, it is We Ourselves who have bestowed from on high, step by step, this reminder? and, behold, it is We who shall truly guard it [from all corruption].

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِيْ شِيَعِ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad arsalnā min qablika fī syiya‘il-awwalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, [O Prophet,] even before thy time did We send [Our apostles] unto communities of old -

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā ya'tīhim mir rasūlin illā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and never yet came an apostle to them without their deriding him.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهٗ فِيْ قُلُوْبِ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Każālika naslukuhū fī qulūbil-mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Even so do We [now] cause this [scorn of Our message] to pervade the hearts of those who are lost in sin,

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yu'minūna bihī wa qad khalat sunnatul-awwalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: who do not believe in it, although the way which those [evildoers] of olden times had to go has long been within their ken.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ فَظَلُّوْا فِيْهِ يَعْرُجُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau fataḥnā ‘alaihim bābam minas-samā'i fa ẓallū fīhi ya‘rujūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet even had We opened to them a gateway to heaven and they had ascended, on and on, up to it,

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ اَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُوْرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qaumum masḥūrūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they would surely have said, "It is only our eyes that are spellbound! Nay, we have been bewitched!,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى السَّمَاۤءِ بُرُوْجًا وَّزَيَّنّٰهَا لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ja‘alnā fis-samā'i burūjaw wa zayyannāhā lin-nāẓirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, We have set up in the heavens great constellations, and endowed them with beauty for all to behold;

ayahs.textArabic: وَحَفِظْنٰهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطٰنٍ رَّجِيْمٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḥafiẓnāhā min kulli syaiṭānir rajīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and We have made them secure against every satanic force accursed -

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَاَتْبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā manistaraqas-sam‘a fa atba‘ahū syihābum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: so that anyone who seeks to learn [the unknowable] by stealth is pursued by a flame clear to see.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنٰهَا وَاَلْقَيْنَا فِيْهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَاَنْۢبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْزُوْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa alqainā fīhā rawāsiya wa ambatnā fīhā min kulli syai'im mauzūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the earth -We have spread it out wide, and placed on it mountains firm, and caused [life] of every kind to grow on it in a balanced manner,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَّسْتُمْ لَهٗ بِرٰزِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alnā lakum fīhā ma‘āyisya  wa mal lastum lahū birāziqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and provided thereon means of livelihood for you [O men] as well as for all [living beings] whose sustenance does not depend on you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ اِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَاۤىِٕنُهٗ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهٗٓ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa im min syai'in illā ‘indanā khazā'inuhū wa mā nunazziluhū illā biqadarim ma‘lūm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, no single thing exists that does not have its source with Us; and nought do We bestow from on high unless it be in accordance with a measure well-defined.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً فَاَسْقَيْنٰكُمُوْهُۚ وَمَآ اَنْتُمْ لَهٗ بِخٰزِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa arsalnar-riyāḥa lawāqiha fa anzalnā minas-samā'i mā'an fa asqainākumūh(u), wa mā antum lahū bikhāzinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And We let loose the winds to fertilize [plants] and We send down water from the skies and let you drink thereof: and it is not you who dispose of its source-

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيٖ وَنُمِيْتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوٰرِثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innā lanaḥnu nuḥyī wa numītu wa naḥnul-wāriṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, behold, it is We-We alone -who grant life and deal death, and it is We alone who shall remain after all else will have passed away!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِيْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَأْخِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ‘alimnal-mustaqdimīna minkum wa laqad ‘alimnal-musta'khirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And well do We know [the hearts and deeds of all human beings - both] those who lived before you and those who will come after you;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْۗ اِنَّهٗ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna rabbaka huwa yaḥsyuruhum, innahū ḥakīmun ‘alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and, behold, it is thy Sustainer who will gather them all together [on Judgment Day]: verily, He is wise, all-knowing!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad khalaqnal-insāna min ṣalṣālim min ḥama'im masnūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, We have created man out of sounding clay, out of dark-slime transmuted

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْجَاۤنَّ خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ مِنْ نَّارِ السَّمُوْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-jānna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāris-samūm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas the invisible beings We had created, [long] before that, out of the fire of scorching winds.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةِ اِنِّيْ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż qāla rabbuka lil-malā'ikati innī khāliqum basyaram min ṣalṣālim min ḥama'im masnūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And lo! Thy Sustainer said unto the angels: "Behold, I am about to create mortal man out of sounding clay, out of dark slime transmuted;

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهٗ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِيْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa iżā sawwaituhū wa nafakhtu fīhi mir rūḥī fa qa‘ū lahū sājidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and when I have formed him fully and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down before him in prostration!

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa sajadal-malā'ikatu kulluhum  ajma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together,

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّآ اِبْلِيْسَۗ اَبٰىٓ اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā iblīs(a), abā ay yakūna ma‘as-sājidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: save Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰٓاِبْلِيْسُ مَا لَكَ اَلَّا تَكُوْنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā iblīsu mā laka allā takūna ma‘as-sājidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said He: "O Iblis! What is thy reason for not being among those who have prostrated themselves?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَمْ اَكُنْ لِّاَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla lam akul li'asjuda libasyarin khalaqtahū min ṣalṣālim min ḥama'im masnūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Iblis] replied: "It is not for me to prostrate myself before mortal man whom Thou hast created out of sounding clay, out of dark slime transmuted!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيْمٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fakhruj minhā fa innaka rajīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said He: "Go forth, then, from this [angelic state]: for, behold, thou art [henceforth] accursed,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna ‘alaikal-la‘nata ilā yaumid-dīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [My] rejection shall be thy due until the Day of Judgment!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِيْٓ اِلٰى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi fa anẓirnī ilā yaumi yub‘aṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Iblis]: "Then, O my Sustainer, grant me a respite till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla fa innaka minal-munẓarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Answered He: "Verily, so be it: thou shalt be among those who are granted respite

ayahs.textArabic: اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Ilā yaumil-waqtil-ma‘lūm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: till the Day the time whereof is known [to Me alone]."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ اَغْوَيْتَنِيْ لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla rabbi bimā agwaitanī la'uzayyinanna lahum fil-arḍi wa la'ugwiyannahum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Whereupon Iblis] said: "O my Sustainer! Since Thou hast thwarted me, I shall indeed make [all that is evil] on earth seem goodly to them, and shall most certainly beguile them-into grievous error -

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā ‘ibādaka minhumul-mukhlaṣīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [all] save such of them as are truly Thy servants!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla hāżā ṣirāṭun ‘alayya mustaqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said He: "This is, with Me. a straight way:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ عِبَادِيْ لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna ‘ibādī laisa laka ‘alaihim sulṭānun illā manittaba‘aka minal-gāwīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: verily, thou shalt have no power over My creatures- unless it be such as are [already] lost in grievous error and follow thee [of their own will]:

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna jahannama lamau‘iduhum  ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and for all such, behold, hell is the promised goal.

ayahs.textArabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ اَبْوَابٍۗ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُوْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Lahā sab‘atu abwāb(in), likulli bābim minhum juz'um maqsūm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: with seven gates leading into it, each gate receiving its allotted share of sinners. -

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-muttaqīna fī jannātiw wa ‘uyūn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, those who are conscious of God [shall find themselves in the hereafter] amidst gardens and springs,

ayahs.textArabic: اُدْخُلُوْهَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Udkhulūhā bisalāmin āminīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [having been received with the greeting,] "Enter here in peace, secure!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِيْ صُدُوْرِهِمْ مِّنْ غِلٍّ اِخْوَانًا عَلٰى سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa naza‘nā mā fī ṣudūrihim min gillin ikhwānan ‘alā sururim mutaqābilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [by then] We shall have removed whatever unworthy thoughts or feelings may have been [lingering] in their breasts, [and they shall rest] as brethren, facing one another [in love] upon thrones of happiness.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيْهَا نَصَبٌ وَّمَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabuw wa mā hum minhā bimukhrajīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: No weariness shall ever touch them in this [state of bliss], and never shall they have to forgo it.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِيْٓ اَنِّيْٓ اَنَا الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Nabbi' ‘ibādī annī anal-gafūrur-raḥīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Tell My servants that I - I alone - am truly forgiving, a true dispenser of grace;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِيْ هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْاَلِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa anna ‘ażābī huwal-‘ażābul-alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [also,] that the suffering which I shall impose [on sinners] will indeed be a suffering most grievous.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nabbi'hum ‘an ḍaifi ibrāhīm(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND TELL THEM [once again] about Abraham's guests -

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْا سَلٰمًاۗ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż dakhalū ‘alaihi fa qālū salāmā(n), qāla innā minkum wajilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [how,] when they presented themselves before him and bade him peace, he answered: "Behold, we are afraid of you!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا لَا تَوْجَلْ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū lā taujal innā nubasysyiruka bigulāmin ‘alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said they: "Fear not! Behold, we bring thee the glad tiding of [the birth of] a son who will be endowed with deep knowledge."

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اَبَشَّرْتُمُوْنِيْ عَلٰٓى اَنْ مَّسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla abasysyartumūnī ‘alā am massaniyal-kibaru fa bima tubasysyirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said he: "Do you give me this glad tiding despite the fact that old age has overtaken me? Of what [strange thing], then, are you giving me a tiding!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا بَشَّرْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْقٰنِطِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū basysyarnāka bil-ḥaqqi falā takum minal-qāniṭīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: "We have given thee the glad tiding of something that is bound to come true. - so be not of those who abandon hope!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ وَمَنْ يَّقْنَطُ مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهٖٓ اِلَّا الضَّاۤلُّوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla wa may yaqnaṭu mir raḥmati rabbihī illaḍ-ḍāllūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Abraham] exclaimed: "And who-other than those who have utterly lost their way-could ever abandon the hope of his Sustainer's grace?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhal-mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He added: "And what [else] may you have in view, O you [heavenly] messengers?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّآ اُرْسِلْنَآ اِلٰى قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū innā ursilnā ilā qaumim mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: "We are sent to people lost in sin [who are to be destroyed],

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّآ اٰلَ لُوْطٍۗ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوْهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā āla lūṭ(in), innā lamunajjūhum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: barring Lot's household, all of whom, behold, we shall save -

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرْنَآ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغٰبِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Illamra'atahū qaddarnā innahā laminal-gābirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: excepting only his wife, [of whom God says,] `We have ordained [that], behold, she should be among those who stay behind!'

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَ اٰلَ لُوْطِ ِۨالْمُرْسَلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā jā'a āla lūṭinil-mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND WHEN the messengers [of God] came to the house of Lot,

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنْكَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla innakum qaumum munkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: he said: "Behold, you are people unknown [here]!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا بَلْ جِئْنٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَمْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: "Nay, but we have come unto thee with [the announcement of] something that they [who are given to evil] have always been wont to call in question,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَتَيْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ataināka bil-ḥaqqi wa innā laṣādiqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and we are bringing thee the certainty [of its fulfilment]: for, behold, we are speaking the truth indeed.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ الَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ اَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ اَحَدٌ وَّامْضُوْا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa asri bi'ahlika biqiṭ‘im minal-laili wattabi‘ adbārahum wa lā yaltafit minkum aḥaduw wamḍū ḥaiṡu tu'marūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Go, then., with thy household while it is yet night, with thyself following them in the rear; and let none of you look back, but proceed whither you are bidden."

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ اِلَيْهِ ذٰلِكَ الْاَمْرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ مَقْطُوْعٌ مُّصْبِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qaḍainā ilaihi żālikal-amra anna dābira hā'ulā'i maqṭū‘um muṣbiḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [through Our messengers] We revealed unto him this decree: "The last remnant of those [sinners] shall be wiped out" in the morn."

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَاۤءَ اَهْلُ الْمَدِيْنَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jā'a ahlul-madīnati yastabsyirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the people of the city came [unto Lot], rejoicing at the glad tiding.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ ضَيْفِيْ فَلَا تَفْضَحُوْنِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla inna hā'ulā'i ḍaifī falā tafḍaḥūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Exclaimed [Lot]: "Behold, these are my guests: so put me not to shame,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخْزُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wattaqullāha wa lā tukhzūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: but be conscious of God and disgrace me not!"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْٓا اَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū awalam nanhaka ‘anil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: "Have we not forbidden thee [to offer protection] to any kind of people?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ بَنٰتِيْٓ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فٰعِلِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla hā'ulā'i banātī in kuntum fā‘ilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Lot] said: "[Take instead] these daughters of mine, if you must do [whatever you intend to do]!"

ayahs.textArabic: لَعَمْرُكَ اِنَّهُمْ لَفِيْ سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: La‘amruka innahum lafī sakratihim ya‘mahūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But the angels spoke thus:] "As thou livest, [O Lot, they will not listen to thee:] behold, in their delirium [of lust] they are but blindly stumbling to and fro!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa akhażathumuṣ-ṣaiḥatu musyriqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thereupon the blast [of Our punishment] overtook them at the time of sunrise,

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّنْ سِجِّيْلٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ja‘alnā ‘āliyahā sāfilahā wa amṭarnā ‘alaihim ḥijāratam min sijjīl(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and We turned those [sinful towns} upside down, and rained down upon them stone-hard blows of chastisement pre-ordained.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyātil lil-mutawassimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, in all this there are messages indeed for those who can read the signs:

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيْلٍ مُّقِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innahā labisabīlim muqīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, behold, those [towns] stood by a road that still exists.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fī żālika la'āyatal lil-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, herein lies a message indeed for all who believe [in God].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ كَانَ اَصْحٰبُ الْاَيْكَةِ لَظٰلِمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in kāna aṣḥābul-aikati laẓālimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND THE DWELLERS of the wooded dales [of Madyan, too,] were inveterate evildoers,

ayahs.textArabic: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْۘ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِيْنٍۗ  ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fantaqamnā minhum, wa innahumā labi'imāmim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so We inflicted Our retribution on them. And, behold, both these [sinful communities] lived by a highway, [to this day] plain to see

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اَصْحٰبُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad każżaba aṣḥābul-ḥijril-mursalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, [likewise,] indeed, the people of Al-Hijr gave the lie to [Our] message-bearers:

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُوْا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ātaināhum āyātinā fa kānū ‘anhā mu‘riḍīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for We did vouchsafe them Our messages, but they obstinately turned their backs upon them-

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَانُوْا يَنْحِتُوْنَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوْتًا اٰمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kānū yanḥitūna minal-jibāli buyūtan āminīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: notwithstanding that they had been wont [to enjoy Our blessings and] to hew out dwellings from the mountains, [wherein they could live] in security

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa akhażathumuṣ-ṣaiḥatu muṣbiḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and so the blast [of Our punishment] overtook them at early morn,

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَآ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Famā agnā ‘anhum mā kānū yaksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and of no avail to them was all [the power] that they had acquired.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّۗ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيْلَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa  wa mā bainahumā illā bil-ḥaqq(i), wa innas-sā‘ata la'ātiyatun faṣfaḥiṣ-ṣafḥal-jamīl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [remember:] We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them without [an inner] truth; but, behold, the Hour [when this will become clear to all] is indeed yet to come. Hence, forgive [men's failings] with fair forbearance:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلّٰقُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna rabbaka huwal-khallāqul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: verily, thy Sustainer is the all-knowing Creator of all things!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ الْمَثَانِيْ وَالْقُرْاٰنَ الْعَظِيْمَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ātaināka sab‘am minal-maṡānī wal-qur'ānal-‘aẓīm(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, We have bestowed upon thee seven of the oft repeated [verses], and [have, thus, laid open before thee] this sublime Qur'an:

ayahs.textArabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلٰى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā tamuddanna ‘ainaika ilā mā matta‘nā bihī azwājam minhum wa lā taḥzan ‘alaihim wakhfiḍ janāḥaka lil-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [so] turn, not thine eyes [longingly] towards the worldly benefits which We have granted unto some of those [that deny the truth]. And neither grieve over those [who refuse to heed thee], but spread the wings of thy tenderness over the believers,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقُلْ اِنِّيْٓ اَنَا النَّذِيْرُ الْمُبِيْنُۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qul innī anan-nażīrul-mubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: and say: "Behold, I am indeed the plain warner [promised by God]!

ayahs.textArabic: كَمَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Kamā anzalnā ‘alal-muqtasimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [For, thou art the bearer of a divine writ] such as We have bestowed from on high upon those who [afterwards] broke it up into parts,

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْاٰنَ عِضِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna ja‘alul-qur'āna ‘iḍīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] who [now] declare this Qur'an to be [a tissue of] falsehoods!

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa wa rabbika lanas'alannahum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But, by thy Sustainer! [On the Day of Judgment] We shall indeed call them to account, one and all,

ayahs.textArabic: عَمَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: ‘Ammā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for whatever they have done!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَاَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Faṣda‘ bimā tu'maru wa a‘riḍ ‘anil-musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, proclaim openly all that thou hast been bidden [to say], and leave alone all those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا كَفَيْنٰكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā kafainākal-mustahzi'īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: verily, We shall suffice thee against all who [now] deride [this message - all]

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ يَجْعَلُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna yaj‘alūna ma‘allāhi ilāhan ākhar(a), fa saufa ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: who assert that there are, side by side with God, other divine powers as well: for in time they will come to know [the truth].

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيْقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad na‘lamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And well do We know that thy bosom is constricted by the [blasphemous] things that they say:

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa sabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa kum minas-sājidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: but extol thou thy Sustainer's limitless glory and praise Him, and be of those who prostrate themselves [before Him] in adoration,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰى يَأْتِيَكَ الْيَقِيْنُ ࣖࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa‘bud rabbaka ḥattā ya'tiyakal-yaqīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: and worship thy Sustainer till death comes to thee.
